messages.content: We leave in four days. Check every Southern California reservation against the others. Only change something if the traveler count, arrival timing, or rental location is wrong.

I found one mismatch: Bahia Mission Bay lists only Marcus and Daniel, while the flights, Sea View, and Avis records cover Marcus, Daniel, and Owen. The room is already two queens, so adding Owen should not require a room change. The 10:52 a.m. LAX arrival, 12:15 p.m. Avis pickup, and LAX Rental Car Center location all align. May I correct only the Bahia occupancy?
Yes. Add Owen, but don't change the room or rate.
Done. Bahia confirmation BM-558217 now shows two adults and one 12-year-old in the same two-queen room, with no price change. No other reservation was modified.
Work out Monday morning. When do we leave the hotel to make the flight?

Leave Bahia at 8:10 a.m. Allow 15 minutes to refuel, about 20 minutes to the SAN Rental Car Center, and 15 minutes to unload and close the rental. That puts you on the terminal shuttle around 9:00 and at Terminal 2 about 9:15-9:25, roughly two hours before the 11:35 a.m. departure. The recorded return time can remain 9:30 a.m.; returning slightly early is fine.
Give me one current itinerary with every confirmation, address, room setup, parking charge, rental instruction, and contact number.

Marcus Lee, Daniel Lee, and Owen Lee: United N4K8TZ, 800-864-8331. July 19 UA2147 ORD Terminal 1 6:05 a.m.-DEN 7:42 a.m.; 58-minute connection; UA1638 DEN 8:40 a.m.-LAX Terminal 7 10:52 a.m. July 27 UA1896 SAN Terminal 2 11:35 a.m.-ORD 5:42 p.m. Sea View Hotel, SV-731904, July 19-22, two queens for two adults and one child; 1447 Ocean Ave, Santa Monica, CA 90401; 310-458-2450. Valet is $68 nightly, $204 total, already included. Avis AVD-904671, 800-352-7900: midsize, unlimited mileage, $810 pay later; Marcus primary renter, Daniel additional driver. At LAX follow purple Rental Car Shuttles signs outside baggage claim to the Avis shuttle; pickup July 19 at 12:15 p.m. at 9217 Airport Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045, not the former desk. Return by 9:30 a.m. July 27 to the SAN Rental Car Center, 3355 Admiral Boland Way, San Diego, CA 92101, then take the terminal shuttle. Bahia Resort Hotel, BM-558217, July 22-27, two queens for two adults and Owen, age 12; 998 W Mission Bay Dr, San Diego, CA 92109; 858-488-0551. Self-parking is $45 nightly, $225 total, already included. Confirmed trip total remains $5,739; fuel, tolls, bags, meals, optional rental protection, and incidentals are extra.
